scope: First ten unreviewed anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins originals in cohort order; prerequisite review only.
source_reader: Delegated complete-original-body review; report persisted by the parent because the research agent had read-only tools.
linked_reference_caveat: Linked references and related skills were not reviewed. These are prerequisite assessments, not task executions, permanent exclusions or verified service/human actions.

sources.workflow: Audit a design or page, classify accessibility findings, and recommend fixes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A design, page, or description; the prescribed tests include keyboard navigation, assistive technology, contrast and zoom.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied static material can support a limited review. Actual interaction and screen-reader behavior require an appropriate UI and runtime; tracker actions require its service.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The reviewed material, test environment, measurements, interaction observations and evidence for each finding.

sources.workflow: Gather account context, draft or refresh a plan, and propose or apply selected CRM highlights.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An account identifier and relevant account information; missing required inputs are requested. CRM writes depend on the applicable user decision and connector permissions.
sources.offline_assessment: Uploaded account rows and notes can support a plan and update checklist. Live schema checks, document updates and verified CRM writes need the relevant services.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Source records or uploads, plan and citations, proposed changes, user decisions, and any write-and-readback evidence.

sources.workflow: Analyze campaign performance and attribution, recommend dollar-denominated changes, draft creative, and seek separate approval for each execution.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Campaign performance data; closed-business data for reconciliation where available; voice examples if no profile exists; explicit approval for each change.
sources.offline_assessment: Exports can support analysis, drafts and owner click instructions. Actual platform changes and connected creative generation need the respective service and, for changes, the owner's approval.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Source exports and mappings, attribution calculations, recommendations, creative inputs, individual approvals and any platform change evidence.

sources.workflow: Interpret a data question, gather data, analyze and validate it, then present findings at the requested level of detail.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A question and relevant data, or a schema for queries the user will execute.
sources.offline_assessment: Provided files or results can support offline analysis and validation. Claims about a live warehouse require access to that warehouse or trustworthy supplied results.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The question, source data or query results, queries, calculations, validation checks and caveats.

sources.workflow: Support control scoping, sampling, testing workpapers, deficiency evaluation and remediation planning.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Control descriptions, risks, complete populations, testing evidence and qualified financial-professional review.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied populations and evidence can support draft sampling and workpapers. Actual control operation, observation, approvals and professional conclusions require appropriate real evidence and review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Population completeness evidence, sampling method and selections, item-level evidence, exceptions, conclusions and tester/reviewer sign-offs.

sources.workflow: Capture a recurring task, distinguish variables and judgment, author a gated skill, test it on a known case, register it and offer scheduling or sharing.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An owner walkthrough or description and a known-answer case; consequential actions need approval gates.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied walkthrough can support a draft skill and test design. Demonstrating a real test, routing, scheduling or sharing requires the corresponding runtime and human decisions.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The task specification, authored skill, known-case comparison, corrections, registration evidence and any scheduling or sharing approval.

sources.workflow: Gather dashboard requirements and data, build an HTML dashboard with charts, filters and tables, then open and check it.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A dashboard description and data or a described sample schema; browser rendering is part of the stated workflow.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied data can support local generation. The original calls the dashboard offline but its template loads chart libraries externally, so offline functionality requires those dependencies to be available locally; rendering and interactions need browser evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Requirements, data provenance, generated file and dependencies, plus browser checks of charts, filters, sorting and offline behavior.

sources.workflow: Research an account and attendees, synthesize signal-grounded talking points and perform a supplementary recency check.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A company name; attendee names are optional, with a calendar lookup or question to fill gaps. The workflow calls for account and contact research.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied, dated snapshot can support a bounded synthesis. Current service signals, calendar discovery and the prescribed recency check require their respective sources; sparse data must not be filled with invented details.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Account and attendee source results, their dates, recency-check evidence, and traceability from each talking point to a real signal.

sources.workflow: Assess team capacity and upcoming demand, identify bottlenecks and compare allocation scenarios.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Team size and roles, current and upcoming work, and constraints such as budget, timing and skills.
sources.offline_assessment: Provided workload and availability data can support calculations and scenarios. Automatic tracker and calendar pulls require those services.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Source workload and availability, assumptions, calculations, scenario inputs and resulting recommendations.

sources.workflow: Sequence and track month-end close activities, dependencies, blockers and improvement opportunities.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Close-task information, owners, deadlines and dependencies; the source calls for qualified financial-professional review. Its accelerated close lists additional automation and process prerequisites.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied close information can support a calendar, dependency map and status report. Actual postings, reconciliations, management review and period lock need real system and human evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Task and dependency records, supporting close evidence, approvals, system postings and period-lock evidence where claimed.
